items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...what is his name again? Bob Lyons. Bob Lyons and this other fellow played guitar... [INTERVIEWEE] Not the economy hall. No, the old fellow's hall. No, no, no. You talk about the... Right in that point, the old fellow's hall. No, no, that wasn't the old fellow's hall. That's the hall

ctx.x: Eureka Hall down there. I guess if I go down there somebody might tell me around there would know where they are. Well did you guys go back at the school halls back there?

That's me. Eureka. I'm talking about them old halls. Yeah, because I know Bob played back in the school there back there. He played at the school. Yeah. The school that's built there. The school that's built there. I'm speaking about when the halls was down there when Charlie McDowell and them was down there with boys. The Ricker and them. I know the name of them was too hard, but I didn't know.
Well that's all right. You might find they might still be there. Yes.
